AI Stock Market Rout Triggers Flight to Safe-Haven Assets

A significant downturn in the Artificial Intelligence (AI) stock market has prompted investors to seek refuge in safer assets, with a particular focus on bonds. This stock market rout, originating in South Korea, is seen as a double threat to the ongoing AI boom. Analysts are questioning whether bonds are once again becoming a safe haven for investment amidst this volatility.
